result.title: MERIT: Scaling KG Foundation Models with Relation Transformers
result.summary: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) predict links on unseen graphs zero-shot. KGFMs have been pioneered by ULTRA which builds a relation graph from co-occurrences that match motif templates, and passes messages over it to obtain relation representations. More recent KGFMs such as MOTIF and TRIX increase the size of this relation graph, and FLOCK replaces message-passing with probabilistic random-walk ensembles. However, larger relation graphs mean more messages, and more walks mean more sequences to encode, so they improve performance at higher training and inference cost. This cost hinders their use in more complex reasoning tasks, such as complex query answering. To reverse this trend, we design MERIT, the first KGFM with a transformer relation encoder: every relation name attends to every other, and the motifs enter as a soft prior rather than as edges. Over 56 benchmarks, MERIT matches the zero-shot MRR of SoTA KGFMs while being 6x faster than TRIX and over 100x faster than FLOCK at inference. Fine-tuned for complex query answering like UltraQuery, MERITQuery improves over it at matched cost.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 MERIT，用 transformer 关系编码器替代知识图谱基础模型中的图消息传递与随机游走集成，让关系名之间全注意力交互、把 motif 作为软先验，在 56 个基准上以更低推理成本匹配零样本链接预测性能。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以全注意力加软结构先验取代显式图消息传递」的做法，可能为 LVR 中实体关系表示与推理状态更新、以及结构信息的软注入提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是 KG 链接预测，与视觉或多模态推理并无直接关联。
